seed: The setup window as one step at a time, on a Mac that has never run Photonz and has sorted nothing: Screen Recording, the microphone, the screenshot keys and Photonz in the agent tools are all still to do, so every step shows, with a counter, each with its own action and a Skip. Skipping through them ends on the tour offer, and the next launch shows nothing, because every step was seen once. At Next defaults, no switch changed. The agents step reads the agent tools from a home folder of the walk's own, so its Install is real and touches nothing of the person's.

steps.note: step 1 of 4: what Screen Recording is for, that everything else works without it, the one button that opens the right Settings pane, and Skip

step 4 of 4: a picture of an agent asking Photonz for a redline, two plain sentences, an Install for each tool found on this Mac, and the line saying Ask needs no setup until you use it. Nothing installed yet.
Install set Photonz up in Claude Code, in the walk's own home: the row says Installed and Continue takes over from Skip
the last page: the one tour offer, the screenshot keys, and the one line saying anything skipped is in Settings and the menu bar menu
the next launch shows nothing: every step was seen once and skipping it was an answer, though Screen Recording, the microphone and the keys are still not done
